Selector definition and results
Exact parent ground probabilities at each field are the ideal test oracle.
Vacuum-only and field-only spaces take the largest \(R\) probabilities.
Pool candidates are the union of the three top-\(R\) lists, truncated back
to \(R\) by equal-weight summed probabilities; ties use determinant index.
This is not a finite-shot sample, an ADAPT-QSCI state or response-aware SCI.
The raw pool dimensions at \(R=8,16,32\) are 12,19,36, respectively.
All endpoint diagonalisation and the static expectation use each selected
common space, rather than separately selected endpoint wavefunctions.
